notes: This is an in-process integration test: MSC 1 boots a real RemoteAPIServer on a real loopback TCP socket and drives it with actual HTTP requests, not a pure function call. 'tokenMap' is the fixed token/role/permission table every test in this source file shares (RemoteAPIIntegrationTestCase.tokenMap); 'token' fields in requests reference it by key, except literal invalid tokens used to test auth failure. scToken holds only the 'serverControl' permission: it grants /start, but /settings is gated behind a different permission category the token lacks, and /users is admin-only with no permission category at all — named tokens can never reach it regardless of which permissions they hold.
